question: How broadly should the hrīṃ-trīṃ-huṃ formula ending in obeisance to Vajrā be applied?
premises: The formula consists of hrīṃ, trīṃ, huṃ.
It is addressed to Vajrā and ends with obeisance.
It is to be applied in all cases.
inference: The hrīṃ-trīṃ-huṃ formula ending with obeisance to Vajrā should be applied in all relevant placements.
uncertainties: The exact scope of sakaleṣvapi depends on the ritual context.
plain_english: And hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ, ending with obeisance to Vajrā, should be used in all cases as well.
